target_definition: static relative permittivity of a pure liquid (epsilon_r)

verdict.combat: REJECTED as a static-permittivity source. `De` is provably not the static epsilon for polar liquids (N-methylacetamide 3.97 vs 178.47, acetonitrile 22.23 vs 37.50) while matching nonpolar liquids to <2%. A column with that error pattern mixes definitions and cannot be pooled with the target property.
verdict.liquidbenchmark: ADMITTED for corroboration only. The property is explicitly static (zero frequency) and pure-liquid. But it is ThermoML-derived, so it most likely re-expresses measurements the frozen 239 already use; overlap is computed rather than assumed.
verdict.new_chemistry: LiquidBenchmark contributes 20 compounds outside the frozen 239; ComBat contributes 48 but its dielectric column is rejected. Neither dataset supplies a large independent test set.
